title: Redis Caching Strategies — Companion Examples
title_es: Estrategias de Caché con Redis — Ejemplos
description: Runnable Python examples for the five Redis caching patterns: cache-aside with stampede lock, read-through, write-through, write-behind with batch flush, and refresh-ahead.
description_es: Ejemplos en Python ejecutables de los cinco patrones de caché Redis: cache-aside con lock anti-estampida, read-through, write-through, write-behind con flush por lotes y refresh-ahead.
